terms.label: Backpack
terms.definition: Bag structurally designed for back carry with two shoulder straps visibly attached to the rear body. Position on a person's back alone is insufficient; a one-strap shoulder, hobo, or tote bag remains its construction type.

terms.label: Baguette Bag
terms.definition: Small elongated east-west shoulder bag worn close under the arm.

terms.label: Basket Bag
terms.definition: Bag with an open woven straw, raffia, cane, or basket-like structure.

terms.label: Belt Bag
terms.definition: Small bag attached to or worn like a belt around the waist or hips.

terms.label: Bowling Bag
terms.definition: Rounded structured zip-top bag with paired short handles.

terms.label: Bucket Bag
terms.definition: Upright bag with a rounded or polygonal base and an open or drawstring top.

terms.label: Camera Bag
terms.definition: Compact structured rectangular crossbody bag with a zip-around or top zip.

terms.label: Clutch
terms.definition: Handleless or minimally handled bag intended to be held in the hand.

terms.label: Crescent Bag
terms.definition: Curved shoulder or crossbody bag forming a crescent silhouette.

terms.label: Crossbody Bag
terms.definition: Bag with a long strap designed to cross diagonally over the torso.

terms.label: Doctor Bag
terms.definition: Structured top-handle bag with a wide framed opening and rounded rectangular body.

terms.label: Drawstring Bag
terms.definition: Bag whose top opening closes by pulling a cord or drawstring.

terms.label: Duffle Bag
terms.definition: Soft elongated travel or sport bag with paired handles and a top zip.

terms.label: East-west Bag
terms.definition: Bag with a distinctly elongated horizontal body.

terms.label: Envelope Clutch
terms.definition: Flat clutch with a triangular envelope-style flap.

terms.label: Hobo Bag
terms.definition: Soft crescent or half-moon shoulder bag with a slouching body and one main strap.

terms.label: Messenger Bag
terms.definition: Crossbody bag with a broad strap and large front flap.

terms.label: Minaudiere
terms.definition: Small rigid decorative evening case or box clutch.

terms.label: North-south Bag
terms.definition: Bag with a distinctly tall vertical body.

terms.label: Phone Bag
terms.definition: Small narrow crossbody pouch sized and proportioned for a phone.

terms.label: Saddle Bag
terms.definition: Crossbody or shoulder bag with a curved saddle-like flap and lower edge.

terms.label: Satchel Bag
terms.definition: Structured bag with a flap, top handle, and often a detachable long strap.

terms.label: Shopper Tote
terms.definition: Large open or simply closed tote with two handles and shopping-bag proportions.

terms.label: Shoulder Bag
terms.definition: Bag primarily carried from one shoulder by a short or medium strap.

terms.label: Sling Bag
terms.definition: Compact close-to-body bag built around one diagonal strap for chest or back carry. Do not use for a tote, hobo, shoulder bag, or elongated duffle merely shifted behind the body.

terms.label: Top-handle Bag
terms.definition: Structured or semi-structured bag designed around one or two short top handles.

terms.label: Tote Bag
terms.definition: Open or zip-top bag with two parallel handles and a broadly rectangular carrying body.

terms.label: Trunk Bag
terms.definition: Rigid box-like bag with hard case or trunk-inspired construction.

terms.label: Vanity Case Bag
terms.definition: Compact structured case bag inspired by a cosmetic vanity case.

terms.label: Button-front Cardigan
terms.definition: Openable knit cardigan with a full button front.

terms.label: Coatigan
terms.definition: Heavy long cardigan with coat-like weight and outerwear proportions.

terms.label: Cropped Cardigan
terms.definition: Cardigan ending at or above the natural waist.

terms.label: Longline Cardigan
terms.definition: Cardigan extending below the hip, often to knee or calf.

terms.label: Shawl-collar Cardigan
terms.definition: Cardigan with a continuous rounded shawl collar.

terms.label: Zip Cardigan
terms.definition: Knitted cardigan with a full or partial zipper opening.

terms.label: Balmacaan Coat
terms.definition: Loose single-breasted overcoat with raglan sleeves and a short turned-down collar.

terms.label: blanket coat
terms.definition: Loose, minimally structured coat built from broad blanket-like panels, often wrapping or draping around the body.

terms.label: Cape Coat
terms.definition: Coat whose upper body incorporates a cape-like overlay or arm openings.

terms.label: Car Coat
terms.definition: Straight, practical coat ending around the upper or mid thigh.

terms.label: Chesterfield Coat
terms.definition: Tailored overcoat with a clean straight body and conventional lapels, traditionally with a velvet collar.

terms.label: Cocoon Coat
terms.definition: Rounded, voluminous coat tapering toward the hem.

terms.label: dress coat
terms.definition: Formal coat shaped like a dress, with a defined or fitted waist and a skirt-like lower body.

terms.label: duffle coat
terms.definition: Straight hooded coat identified by toggle-and-loop front fastenings and typically large patch pockets.

terms.label: duster coat
terms.definition: Long, lightweight, loose coat with a simple straight or open front and little internal structure.

terms.label: Field Parka
terms.definition: Utility parka with hood, drawcords, and multiple field pockets.

terms.label: Fishtail Parka
terms.definition: Military-derived parka with a split, elongated fishtail back hem.

terms.label: Greatcoat
terms.definition: Heavy, long military-derived overcoat with substantial coverage.

terms.label: kimono
terms.definition: T-shaped wrap or open-front garment with wide straight sleeves and little or no tailored armhole shaping.

terms.label: Mac Coat
terms.definition: Clean, minimally detailed waterproof coat, commonly single-breasted with a concealed placket.

terms.label: military coat
terms.definition: Structured military-derived coat showing cues such as epaulettes, a high collar, double-breasted closure, or regimented metal buttons.

terms.label: Opera Coat
terms.definition: Formal evening coat with generous volume, often long and minimally structured.

terms.label: Overcoat
terms.definition: Long tailored outer coat intended to be worn over other garments.

terms.label: parka
terms.definition: Hooded utility coat with weather-protective construction, commonly using drawcords and practical flap or patch pockets.

terms.label: pea coat
terms.definition: Short naval-derived coat with a double-breasted front and broad notched or convertible lapels.

terms.label: Polo Coat
terms.definition: Double-breasted, often belted overcoat with broad lapels and a relaxed tailored shape.

terms.label: puffer coat
terms.definition: Longer outer coat whose body is visibly divided into lofted, padded or quilted chambers.

terms.label: raincoat
terms.definition: Protective outer coat with a visibly weather-oriented shell, simple coverage-focused construction, and often a hood or storm details.

terms.label: robe
terms.definition: Loose robe-like outer garment with soft shoulders and an overlapping front, commonly secured by a sash or belt.

terms.label: shearling coat
terms.definition: Coat visibly constructed, lined, or prominently edged with shearling-like fleece and suede surfaces.

terms.label: swing coat
terms.definition: Coat fitted or controlled at the shoulders and flaring broadly toward the hem without a defined waist.

terms.label: teddy bear coat
terms.definition: Soft, rounded coat dominated by a visibly plush, high-pile teddy or faux-fur surface.

terms.label: Topcoat
terms.definition: Relatively lightweight tailored overcoat worn over a suit or separates.

terms.label: trench coat
terms.definition: Belted raincoat family, often double-breasted with storm flaps, epaulettes, and cuff straps.

terms.label: wrap coat
terms.definition: Coat closed by overlapping front panels and a belt or tie rather than a fixed central button or zip closure.

terms.label: Academic Gown
terms.definition: Ceremonial open-front or closed academic robe with a full draped body and wide or slit sleeves, worn for graduation or formal academic dress.

terms.label: Babydoll Dress
terms.definition: Short loose dress gathered from a high empire seam or yoke.

terms.label: Blazer Dress
terms.definition: Dress constructed like an elongated tailored blazer with lapels and front closure.

terms.label: blouson dress
terms.definition: Dress with a loose bodice gathered into the waist so the upper fabric blouses over the waistband.

terms.label: bodycon dress
terms.definition: Close-fitting dress that continuously follows the torso, waist, hip, and leg contours.

terms.label: Bustier Dress
terms.definition: Dress with a fitted shaped-cup bustier bodice.

terms.label: chemise dress
terms.definition: Simple straight or gently loose dress hanging from the shoulders with minimal waist shaping.

terms.label: cheongsams
terms.definition: Qipao or cheongsam-derived fitted dress with a high Mandarin collar, asymmetric upper closure, and often side slits.

terms.label: Corset Dress
terms.definition: Dress with a visibly structured corset-like bodice or boning lines.

terms.label: Drop-waist Dress
terms.definition: Dress whose primary waist seam or skirt begins below the natural waist.

terms.label: gown
terms.definition: Formal full-length or near-full-length dress with an occasionwear bodice and an extended, often elaborate skirt.

terms.label: halter dress
terms.definition: Dress whose bodice is supported or fastened around the neck, leaving the shoulders and much of the upper back exposed.

terms.label: jumper dress
terms.definition: Sleeveless pinafore-like dress designed to be layered over a shirt, blouse, or knit top.

terms.label: kaftan
terms.definition: Loose T-shaped or rectangular robe dress with a wide body, open neckline, and broad integrated sleeves.

terms.label: nightgown
terms.definition: Loose sleepwear dress with lightweight, soft, or lingerie-derived construction intended for nightwear.

terms.label: Polo Dress
terms.definition: Dress with a polo collar and placket.

terms.label: Prairie Dress
terms.definition: Romantic dress with gathered tiers, long or puff sleeves, and modest vintage detailing.

terms.label: Qipao / Cheongsam
terms.definition: Close or straight Chinese-derived dress with a high collar and asymmetric neck opening.

terms.label: sheath dress
terms.definition: Fitted, relatively straight dress shaped close to the waist and hips with little skirt flare.

terms.label: shift dress
terms.definition: Straight loose dress that hangs from the shoulders and shows little or no fitted waist shaping.

terms.label: shirt dress
terms.definition: Dress using recognizable shirt construction such as a collar, front button placket, cuffs, or shirt-tail shaping.

terms.label: skater dress
terms.definition: Dress with a fitted bodice or waist joined to a short, strongly flared circular or A-line skirt.

terms.label: slip dress
terms.definition: Lingerie-inspired dress with narrow straps and a simple fluid body, often using bias-like drape.

terms.label: sundress
terms.definition: Light warm-weather dress with an open neckline and sleeveless or narrow-strap bodice.

terms.label: sweater dress
terms.definition: Knitted pullover garment using sweater construction but extending below the hips as a dress.

terms.label: T-shirt Dress
terms.definition: Dress using the simple body, neckline, and sleeve construction of a T-shirt.

terms.label: Tank Dress
terms.definition: Sleeveless dress with tank-top shoulder and neckline construction.

terms.label: tea dress
terms.definition: Feminine day dress with a defined waist and softly flared skirt, commonly styled in classic mid-length proportions.

terms.label: Tennis Dress
terms.definition: Sport dress with tennis-derived fitted bodice and short flared or pleated skirt.

terms.label: Tube Dress
terms.definition: Strapless dress with a straight or softly shaped upper edge.

terms.label: tunic dress
terms.definition: Loose straight tunic extended to dress length, usually with minimal waist definition and possible side slits.

terms.label: wrap dress
terms.definition: Dress formed by overlapping front panels, usually creating a V neckline and fastening with a waist tie.

terms.label: Aviator Sunglasses
terms.definition: Metal-style frame with large teardrop lenses and a double or thin bridge.

terms.label: Browline Sunglasses
terms.definition: Frame with a visibly heavier upper brow section than the lower rim.

terms.label: Butterfly Sunglasses
terms.definition: Oversized frame widening at the upper outer corners in a butterfly-like shape.

terms.label: Cat-eye Sunglasses
terms.definition: Frame whose upper outer corners sweep upward.

terms.label: Oval Sunglasses
terms.definition: Eyewear with horizontally oval lenses.

terms.label: Rectangular Sunglasses
terms.definition: Eyewear with strongly horizontal rectangular lenses.

terms.label: Rimless Sunglasses
terms.definition: Eyewear with lenses attached without a surrounding full frame.

terms.label: Round Sunglasses
terms.definition: Eyewear with circular or near-circular lenses.

terms.label: Shield Sunglasses
terms.definition: Large continuous or visually unified lens spanning much of the face.

terms.label: Wayfarer Sunglasses
terms.definition: Thick trapezoidal frame with a strong brow line and slightly flared outer corners.

terms.label: Arm Warmers
terms.definition: Tubular or glove-like warmers covering the wrist and forearm, sometimes with a thumb opening.

terms.label: Fingerless Gloves
terms.definition: Gloves leaving all or part of the fingers exposed.

terms.label: Knit Gloves
terms.definition: Full-finger gloves with a visibly knitted construction.

terms.label: Leather Gloves
terms.definition: Full-finger gloves with a smooth leather or leather-like appearance.

terms.label: Mittens
terms.definition: Hand covering with a separate thumb and a shared compartment for the other fingers.

terms.label: Opera Gloves
terms.definition: Formal long gloves extending well above the wrist, often toward the elbow or upper arm.

terms.label: Barrette
terms.definition: Decorative rigid hair clip with a clasp or spring bar fastening.

terms.label: Claw Clip
terms.definition: Hinged hair clip with two interlocking rows of curved teeth.

terms.label: Fascinator
terms.definition: Small decorative headpiece fixed to the hair, often using sculptural textile, feather, or veil elements.

terms.label: Hair Bow
terms.definition: Bow-shaped hair ornament attached by a clip, tie, or barrette.

terms.label: Hair Ribbon
terms.definition: Narrow ribbon visibly tied or woven into the hair.

terms.label: Headband
terms.definition: Band worn over the crown or around the head to hold or decorate the hair.

terms.label: Scrunchie
terms.definition: Fabric-covered elastic hair tie with visible gathered volume.

terms.label: Snap Hair Clip
terms.definition: Thin curved metal-style hair clip that fastens by snapping between concave and convex positions.

terms.label: Balaclava
terms.definition: Close hood covering head and neck with an opening for the face.

terms.label: Baseball Cap
terms.definition: Rounded crown cap with a forward curved or flat visor.

terms.label: Beret
terms.definition: Soft round brimless cap with a flat crown wider than the head opening.

terms.label: Boonie Hat
terms.definition: Utility sun hat with a wider soft brim, ventilation, and often a chin cord.

terms.label: Bucket Hat
terms.definition: Soft crown hat with a narrow downward-sloping brim around the full circumference.

terms.label: Cloche Hat
terms.definition: Close bell-shaped hat fitting low around the head.

terms.label: Cowboy Hat
terms.definition: High-crowned wide-brim hat with western shaping.

terms.label: Cuffed Beanie
terms.definition: Knitted close-fitting cap with a folded cuff.

terms.label: Dad Cap
terms.definition: Soft unstructured low-crown baseball cap with a curved visor.

terms.label: Fedora
terms.definition: Structured felt-style hat with a pinched crown and medium brim.

terms.label: Five-panel Cap
terms.definition: Low-profile cap built from a flat front panel and four surrounding panels.

terms.label: Flat Cap
terms.definition: Low rounded cap whose crown slopes forward to a short visor.

terms.label: Headscarf
terms.definition: Scarf or kerchief visibly folded or tied over the hair as headwear.

terms.label: Mortarboard
terms.definition: Academic headwear with a close skullcap and a rigid flat square board, commonly finished with a tassel.

terms.label: Newsboy Cap
terms.definition: Full paneled soft crown cap with a short visor and top button.

terms.label: Pillbox Hat
terms.definition: Small brimless cylindrical hat with a flat crown.

terms.label: Skullcap
terms.definition: Close-fitting brimless cap covering the crown without the folded cuff or visibly knitted construction that defines a beanie.

terms.label: Trapper Hat
terms.definition: Warm cap with ear flaps and visible insulated or fur-like lining.

terms.label: Trilby
terms.definition: Narrow-brimmed pinched-crown hat with a shorter upturned back brim.

terms.label: Trucker Cap
terms.definition: Baseball-style cap with a foam or structured front and mesh back panels.

terms.label: Uncuffed Beanie
terms.definition: Knitted close-fitting cap with a continuous lower edge and no visible folded cuff.

terms.label: Visor
terms.definition: Brim-only headwear with an open crown.

terms.label: Wide-brim Sun Hat
terms.definition: Hat with a broad all-around brim designed for sun coverage.

terms.label: Ankle Socks
terms.definition: Socks ending at or just above the ankle.

terms.label: Crew Socks
terms.definition: Socks extending to the lower or mid calf.

terms.label: Fishnet Tights
terms.definition: Legwear with an open diamond or net structure.

terms.label: Knee-high Socks
terms.definition: Socks extending to approximately the knee.

terms.label: Leg Warmers
terms.definition: Tubular, usually knitted coverings worn over the lower legs without enclosing the feet.

terms.label: Opaque Tights
terms.definition: One-piece close legwear extending above the thighs with little or no visible transparency.

terms.label: Over-the-knee Socks
terms.definition: Socks extending above the knee.

terms.label: Sheer Tights
terms.definition: One-piece close legwear extending above the thighs with a visibly transparent or translucent finish.

terms.label: Slouch Socks
terms.definition: Long soft socks intentionally gathered in folds around the ankle or calf.

terms.label: Tabi Socks
terms.definition: Socks with a separated big-toe section.

terms.label: anorak
terms.definition: Pullover weather jacket with an attached hood, partial front opening, and often a kangaroo or large front pocket.

terms.label: Barn Jacket
terms.definition: Workwear-derived jacket with a corduroy-style collar and roomy patch pockets.

terms.label: biker jacket
terms.definition: Motorcycle-derived fitted jacket with prominent zips, snap details, and lapel or stand-collar construction.

terms.label: blazer
terms.definition: Tailored hip-length jacket with lapels, structured front panels, and a formal buttoned opening.

terms.label: Blouson Jacket
terms.definition: Short jacket gathered or fitted at the waist to create blousing above the hem.

terms.label: bolero
terms.definition: Very short open-front jacket or shrug ending above or around the natural waist.

terms.label: bomber jacket
terms.definition: Waist-length zip jacket with ribbed or elasticated collar, cuffs, and hem creating rounded blouson volume.

terms.label: Cafe Racer Jacket
terms.definition: Minimal fitted leather-style zip jacket with a short stand collar.

terms.label: chanel jacket
terms.definition: Boxy collarless tailored jacket with contrast edge trim, compact proportions, and often patch pockets.

terms.label: Chore Jacket
terms.definition: Workwear jacket with a simple button front and large patch pockets.

terms.label: classic military jacket
terms.definition: Tailored military-derived jacket with structured shoulders and cues such as a stand collar, regimented buttons, or epaulettes.

terms.label: Coach Jacket
terms.definition: Lightweight snap-front jacket with a pointed collar and drawcord hem.

terms.label: Collarless Tweed Jacket
terms.definition: Boxy collarless tailored jacket, commonly in tweed or boucle with edge trim.

terms.label: crop jacket
terms.definition: Jacket intentionally proportioned to end at or above the natural waist rather than at the hip.

terms.label: Double Rider Jacket
terms.definition: Asymmetric zip biker jacket with wide lapels and multiple metal zips.

terms.label: Field Jacket
terms.definition: Military utility jacket with four front pockets and a stand collar or concealed hood.

terms.label: Flight Jacket
terms.definition: Military flight-derived zip jacket, usually cropped with ribbed edges and a sleeve pocket.

terms.label: Harrington Jacket
terms.definition: Waist-length zip jacket with a stand collar and elasticized or ribbed hem.

terms.label: Hood Zip-up
terms.definition: Hooded jacket or sweatshirt with a zipper that visibly opens the full front from hem to neckline; pullover and half-zip hoodies are excluded.

terms.label: mao jacket
terms.definition: Straight jacket with a short standing Mandarin-style collar and a clean, restrained front closure.

terms.label: nehru jacket
terms.definition: Tailored hip-length jacket with a band or Mandarin collar and a full buttoned front.

terms.label: norfolk jacket
terms.definition: Belted sport jacket identified by box pleats or vertical panels and practical patch pockets.

terms.label: pea jacket
terms.definition: Short naval-style jacket with a broad-lapel double-breasted front.

terms.label: puffer jacket
terms.definition: Short outer jacket whose body or sleeves are visibly divided into lofted padded chambers.

terms.label: Quilted Liner Jacket
terms.definition: Light collarless or minimally collared jacket with visible allover quilting.

terms.label: safari jacket
terms.definition: Belted shirt-collar jacket with multiple patch pockets and often epaulettes or a shoulder yoke.

terms.label: Shell Jacket
terms.definition: Light technical weather shell with protective hood, zip, and seam-oriented construction.

terms.label: Shirt Jacket
terms.definition: Outer layer combining a shirt collar and button front with jacket weight or proportions.

terms.label: Smoking Jacket
terms.definition: Soft formal jacket with a shawl collar and lounge-derived proportions.

terms.label: track jacket
terms.definition: Athletic zip-front jacket with a stand collar and sport details such as side stripes, contrast panels, or elastic edges.

terms.label: trucker jacket
terms.definition: Waist-length denim-style jacket with vertical front seams, pointed flap chest pockets, and a button front.

terms.label: tuxedo jacket
terms.definition: Formal tailored jacket distinguished by satin-like peak or shawl lapels and a clean eveningwear front.

terms.label: Utility Jacket
terms.definition: Functional jacket defined by multiple patch or cargo pockets and practical closures.

terms.label: varsity jacket
terms.definition: Collegiate snap-front jacket with striped rib trim and commonly contrast sleeves, letter patches, or chenille emblems.

terms.label: Western Jacket
terms.definition: Jacket with western yokes, pointed pocket flaps, or related cowboy-derived construction.

terms.label: windbreaker
terms.definition: Lightweight weather shell with zip or pullover construction, elastic or drawcord edges, and minimal visible insulation.

terms.label: Zip-front Jacket
terms.definition: Casual non-tailored jacket with a full front zip (often with a snap placket) and a plain shirt or stand collar, without bomber rib trim, biker asymmetry or utility pocket systems; material and fit stay on their axes.

terms.label: Band Ring
terms.definition: Ring whose dominant form is a continuous band without a large raised centerpiece.

terms.label: Bangle
terms.definition: Rigid circular bracelet slipped over or hinged around the wrist.

terms.label: Beaded Necklace
terms.definition: Necklace formed primarily from visible beads or bead-like units.

terms.label: Brooch
terms.definition: Decorative ornament visibly pinned to a garment.

terms.label: Chain Bracelet
terms.definition: Bracelet whose visible linked chain is the main design feature.

terms.label: Chain Necklace
terms.definition: Necklace whose visible chain links are the main design feature.

terms.label: Charm Bracelet
terms.definition: Bracelet carrying multiple small hanging decorative charms.

terms.label: Charm Necklace
terms.definition: Necklace carrying multiple small decorative charms.

terms.label: Choker
terms.definition: Necklace or band fitted closely around the neck.

terms.label: Cuff Bracelet
terms.definition: Broad rigid or semi-rigid bracelet with an open or hinged form.

terms.label: Drop Earrings
terms.definition: Earrings with a visible element hanging below the earlobe.

terms.label: Ear Cuff
terms.definition: Jewellery wrapping around the outer ear without a conventional hanging form.

terms.label: Eternity Ring
terms.definition: Band ring set with a continuous or visually continuous row of similarly sized gem-like stones.

terms.label: Hoop Earrings
terms.definition: Circular or near-circular earrings passing around the earlobe.

terms.label: Huggie Earrings
terms.definition: Small hoop earrings fitting closely around the earlobe.

terms.label: Lariat Necklace
terms.definition: Long necklace without a conventional closed focal form, tied or dropping in a Y shape.

terms.label: Pearl Necklace
terms.definition: Necklace composed primarily of pearl-like beads.

terms.label: Pendant Necklace
terms.definition: Necklace with a distinct hanging central ornament.

terms.label: Signet Ring
terms.definition: Ring with a flat or engraved face as the dominant element.

terms.label: Stacked Rings
terms.definition: Multiple rings deliberately worn together on one or adjacent fingers as a coordinated stack.

terms.label: Statement Ring
terms.definition: Visually prominent ring with an oversized, sculptural, or strongly decorative centerpiece.

terms.label: Stud Earrings
terms.definition: Small earrings sitting directly on the earlobe without a drop.

terms.label: Tennis Bracelet
terms.definition: Flexible bracelet formed by a continuous line of similarly sized gem-like settings.

terms.label: Boiler Suit
terms.definition: Workwear-derived long-sleeve one-piece with a front opening and utility pockets.

terms.label: Catsuit
terms.definition: Close-fitting one-piece garment covering torso and legs.

terms.label: Dungarees / Overalls
terms.definition: Bib-front garment with shoulder straps joined to pants or shorts.

terms.label: Jumpsuit
terms.definition: One-piece garment joining a top to full-length pants.

terms.label: Pinafore Dress
terms.definition: Sleeveless apron-like dress intended to be layered over a top.

terms.label: Romper / Playsuit
terms.definition: One-piece garment joining a top to shorts.

terms.label: Barrel-leg Pants
terms.definition: Pants curving outward through the leg and tapering back toward the ankle.

terms.label: camo pants
terms.definition: Military or utility-style pants whose dominant visible surface is a camouflage pattern; also record camouflage on the pattern axis.

terms.label: capri pants
terms.definition: Cropped slim or straight pants ending around the middle of the calf.

terms.label: cargo pants
terms.definition: Utility pants with one or more prominent expandable or flap cargo pockets on the outer legs.

terms.label: Carpenter Pants
terms.definition: Work pants with a hammer loop, ruler pocket, or reinforced utility details.

terms.label: Chino Pants
terms.definition: Clean cotton-twill-style trousers with slant pockets and restrained detailing.

terms.label: Cigarette Pants
terms.definition: Slim straight ankle-length tailored trousers.

terms.label: crop pants
terms.definition: Pants intentionally ending above the ankle; record the observed hem position on the garment-length axis as well.

terms.label: culottes
terms.definition: Wide-legged divided garment whose legs create a skirt-like silhouette, commonly ending between knee and calf.

terms.label: harem pants
terms.definition: Very loose pants with a dropped crotch and strong taper or gathering toward the ankles.

terms.label: hip-huggers pants
terms.definition: Low-rise pants fitted across the hips with the waistband sitting clearly below the natural waist.

terms.label: jeans
terms.definition: Denim five-pocket trousers with recognizable jean construction such as a yoke, rivets, belt loops, and fly front.

terms.label: jodhpur
terms.definition: Riding-derived pants with volume through the hip or thigh and a close fit from the knee downward.

terms.label: Jogger Pants
terms.definition: Casual pants tapered into elasticated or ribbed ankle cuffs.

terms.label: leggings
terms.definition: Close-fitting stretch pull-on pants that follow the legs continuously and lack conventional tailored trouser volume.

terms.label: Pajama Pants
terms.definition: Loose sleep or lounge pants with an elastic or drawstring waist, soft piping or printed sleepwear fabric, usually worn as a matching set; not athletic sweatshirt fabric.

terms.label: Palazzo Pants
terms.definition: Very wide fluid trousers flaring from the waist or hip.

terms.label: Paperbag-waist Pants
terms.definition: High-waisted pants with gathered fabric extending above the waistband.

terms.label: Parachute Pants
terms.definition: Light voluminous pants with drawcords, cargo details, or gathered ankles.

terms.label: peg pants
terms.definition: Pants with extra volume or pleating at the hips and thighs that taper sharply toward the ankle.

terms.label: Pleated Trousers
terms.definition: Trousers with one or more visible pleats opening from the waistband.

terms.label: Puddle Pants
terms.definition: Extra-long wide or straight pants pooling over the shoes.

terms.label: sailor pants
terms.definition: Naval-derived pants with a high waist and visible buttoned front panel, usually in a straight or wide-leg shape.

terms.label: Stirrup Pants
terms.definition: Close or straight pants with a strap passing under the foot.

terms.label: sweatpants
terms.definition: Soft knit pull-on pants with an elastic or drawstring waist and relaxed athletic construction.

terms.label: Tailored Trousers
terms.definition: Structured trousers with tailored waistband, crease, darts, or pressed construction.

terms.label: track pants
terms.definition: Athletic pants with an elastic waist and sport construction such as side stripes, contrast panels, or technical fabric appearance.

terms.label: Blanket Scarf
terms.definition: Oversized rectangular scarf with broad wrap coverage.

terms.label: Chain Belt
terms.definition: Belt formed primarily from metal chain links.

terms.label: Corset Belt
terms.definition: Wide structured belt with corset-like lacing or paneling.

terms.label: Infinity Scarf
terms.definition: Scarf sewn or formed as a continuous loop.

terms.label: Obi Belt
terms.definition: Wide wrap belt inspired by an obi, usually tied or overlapped.

terms.label: Skinny Scarf
terms.definition: Long narrow scarf with tie-like proportions.

terms.label: Square Scarf
terms.definition: Square scarf folded and worn at the neck, head, or bag.

terms.label: Stole
terms.definition: Long wide formal wrap worn over the shoulders.

terms.label: Waist Belt
terms.definition: A conventional strap belt worn around the waist and secured by a buckle or comparable fastening.

terms.label: Ankle Boot
terms.definition: Boot whose shaft ends at or only slightly above the ankle without a more specific defining construction.

terms.label: Ballet Flat
terms.definition: Low-cut flat shoe with a ballet-slipper-derived topline.

terms.label: Brogue Shoe
terms.definition: Oxford- or derby-family shoe with decorative perforations and often a wingtip toe.

terms.label: Chelsea Boot
terms.definition: Ankle boot with elastic side gussets and no front laces.

terms.label: Clog
terms.definition: Backless or slingback shoe with a substantial rigid-looking sole and rounded upper.

terms.label: Combat Boot
terms.definition: Lace-up ankle or mid-calf boot with military-derived structure and sturdy sole.

terms.label: Court Sneaker
terms.definition: Flat cupsole sneaker with court-derived paneling and restrained cushioning.

terms.label: D'Orsay Shoe
terms.definition: Pump or flat with one or both sides cut away to expose the arch.

terms.label: Derby Shoe
terms.definition: Formal lace-up shoe with open lacing quarters.

terms.label: Engineer Boot
terms.definition: Pull-on sturdy boot with buckle straps at the ankle or shaft.

terms.label: Espadrille
terms.definition: Flat or wedge shoe with a visibly rope- or jute-wrapped sole edge.

terms.label: Fisherman Sandal
terms.definition: Closed- or semi-closed-toe sandal with interwoven straps and an ankle fastening.

terms.label: Flip-flop
terms.definition: Open sandal held by a Y-shaped thong between the toes.

terms.label: Gladiator Sandal
terms.definition: Open sandal with multiple straps extending around the ankle or up the lower leg.

terms.label: High-top Sneaker
terms.definition: Sneaker whose upper extends over the ankle.

terms.label: Horsebit Loafer
terms.definition: Loafer with a metal horsebit-style ornament across the vamp.

terms.label: Knee-high Boot
terms.definition: Boot whose shaft reaches approximately to the knee.

terms.label: Loafer
terms.definition: Laceless low shoe with a moccasin-like vamp and defined tongue or apron.

terms.label: Low-top Sneaker
terms.definition: Sneaker whose collar ends below the ankle.

terms.label: Mary Jane
terms.definition: Closed-toe shoe with one or more straps crossing the instep.

terms.label: Moccasin
terms.definition: Soft low shoe with visible moccasin seam construction around the toe.

terms.label: Monk-strap Shoe
terms.definition: Closed formal shoe fastened with one or two buckle straps instead of laces.

terms.label: Mule
terms.definition: Backless shoe with a closed or open toe.

terms.label: Over-the-knee Boot
terms.definition: Boot whose shaft extends above the knee.

terms.label: Oxford Shoe
terms.definition: Formal lace-up shoe with closed lacing quarters.

terms.label: Penny Loafer
terms.definition: Loafer with a slotted strap across the vamp.

terms.label: Performance Runner
terms.definition: Technical running shoe with visible cushioning geometry, breathable upper, and performance outsole.

terms.label: Pump
terms.definition: Low-cut heeled shoe without an instep fastening.

terms.label: Rain Boot
terms.definition: Waterproof molded or rubber-looking boot with a simple protective shaft.

terms.label: Retro Runner
terms.definition: Lifestyle sneaker using vintage running-shoe mesh, suede overlays, and low wedge cushioning.

terms.label: Riding Boot
terms.definition: Tall, relatively clean boot with a low heel and riding-derived shaft.

terms.label: Shearling Boot
terms.definition: Boot with clearly visible shearling, fleece, or plush warm lining.

terms.label: Skate Sneaker
terms.definition: Flat durable sneaker with a padded upper and board-oriented cupsole or vulcanized sole.

terms.label: Slide
terms.definition: Backless open-toe sandal with one or more straps over the forefoot.

terms.label: Slingback
terms.definition: Shoe with an open heel secured by a strap around the back of the heel.

terms.label: Slouch Boot
terms.definition: Mid-calf to knee boot whose soft shaft collapses into visible horizontal folds; no buckle straps.

terms.label: Sneakerina
terms.definition: Hybrid sneaker with a ballet-flat profile, low vamp, or instep strap.

terms.label: Sock Boot
terms.definition: Close-fitting stretch boot with a sock-like shaft.

terms.label: Sock Sneaker
terms.definition: Sneaker with a close stretch-knit, sock-like collar and minimal conventional tongue structure.

terms.label: Strappy Sandal
terms.definition: Open sandal whose upper is primarily formed by multiple narrow straps across the foot.

terms.label: Tassel Loafer
terms.definition: Loafer decorated with tassels on the vamp.

terms.label: Trail Runner
terms.definition: Running shoe with aggressive traction and protective trail-oriented upper construction.

terms.label: Western Boot
terms.definition: Pull-on boot with a shaped shaft, pointed or rounded toe, and angled heel.

terms.label: Basketball Shorts
terms.definition: Loose knee-area athletic shorts, often mesh with a broad elastic waistband.

terms.label: bermuda shorts
terms.definition: Clean or tailored longer shorts ending close to the knee with a relatively straight leg.

terms.label: Biker Shorts
terms.definition: Close-fitting stretch shorts ending around mid thigh or above the knee.

terms.label: bloomers
terms.definition: Loose shorts gathered into the waist and leg openings, producing rounded puffed volume.

terms.label: boardshorts
terms.definition: Surf or swim shorts with a flat or tie-front waistband, longer loose legs, and visibly performance-oriented construction.

terms.label: booty shorts
terms.definition: Extremely short close-fitting shorts with minimal coverage across the upper thigh and seat.

terms.label: Boxer Shorts
terms.definition: Loose shorts with an elastic waist and underwear-derived straight construction.

terms.label: cargo shorts
terms.definition: Utility shorts with prominent expandable or flap cargo pockets on the outer legs.

terms.label: Chino Shorts
terms.definition: Clean twill-style shorts with a trouser waistband and slant pockets.

terms.label: culotte shorts
terms.definition: Very wide flared shorts whose divided legs resemble a short skirt.

terms.label: Dolphin Shorts
terms.definition: Athletic shorts with curved side hems and contrast binding or piping.

terms.label: Hot Pants
terms.definition: Very short fitted or deliberately shaped outer shorts with minimal leg coverage; do not use for relaxed generic upper-thigh shorts.

terms.label: lounge shorts
terms.definition: Relaxed soft pull-on shorts with an elastic or drawstring waist and minimal tailored structure.

terms.label: roll-up shorts
terms.definition: Shorts whose hems are visibly rolled or turned into cuffs.

terms.label: Running Shorts
terms.definition: Light performance shorts with a short inseam, split or curved hem, and sport waistband.

terms.label: short shorts
terms.definition: Generic shorts ending high on the upper thigh, regardless of relaxed or fitted shape. Use Hot Pants only when the deliberately body-shaped micro-short construction is itself visible.

terms.label: skort
terms.definition: Shorts with two functional leg openings plus a visibly attached skirt-like front or wrap panel. Plain tailored shorts without that overlay are not a skort.

terms.label: Tailored Shorts
terms.definition: Structured shorts with a trouser-style waistband, pleats, darts, or pressed details and two visibly separate leg openings; a skirt-like front overlay is a skort, not tailored shorts.

terms.label: tie-up shorts
terms.definition: Shorts whose waistband or front closure is visually defined by a prominent fabric tie or belt.

terms.label: trunks
terms.definition: Short swim or athletic bottoms with a simple elastic or drawstring waist and compact leg coverage.

terms.label: accordion skirt
terms.definition: Skirt with many narrow, evenly spaced permanent pleats that open and close like an accordion.

terms.label: ball gown skirt
terms.definition: Formal skirt with exceptional floor-directed volume created by gathering, layers, or internal structure.

terms.label: Bias-cut Skirt
terms.definition: Fluid skirt whose fabric hangs diagonally and closely follows the body.

terms.label: Bubble Skirt
terms.definition: Rounded skirt with volume tucked or gathered into a narrower hem.

terms.label: cargo skirt
terms.definition: Utility skirt with one or more prominent expandable or flap cargo pockets.

terms.label: Column Skirt
terms.definition: Long narrow skirt falling in a mostly straight vertical line.

terms.label: dirndl skirt
terms.definition: Full skirt densely gathered or pleated into a fitted waistband, derived from traditional dirndl construction.

terms.label: Fishtail Skirt
terms.definition: Fitted skirt that flares markedly near the lower hem.

terms.label: flamenco skirt
terms.definition: Dramatic dance-derived skirt with large ruffles, flounces, or tiers that create pronounced movement.

terms.label: godet skirt
terms.definition: Skirt fitted above and flared below by triangular godet inserts visible between the main panels.

terms.label: gypsy skirt
terms.definition: Long full bohemian-style skirt built from gathered tiers or broad flowing panels; the source term is retained for taxonomy compatibility.

terms.label: Handkerchief Skirt
terms.definition: Skirt with multiple pointed or uneven draped hem sections.

terms.label: hobble skirt
terms.definition: Long narrow skirt that visibly constricts around the knees or lower legs and limits stride width.

terms.label: kilt
terms.definition: Pleated wrap skirt with a flat front apron and side fastening, with tartan common but not required.

terms.label: prairie skirt
terms.definition: Long modest skirt with gathered tiers, ruffles, or flounces and a western rural styling vocabulary.

terms.label: rah-rah skirt
terms.definition: Short cheerleader-derived skirt made from layered flounces or crisp projecting pleats.

terms.label: Ruffle Skirt
terms.definition: Skirt dominated by one or more ruffled or flounced sections.

terms.label: sarong skirt
terms.definition: Skirt formed from a rectangular cloth wrapped, overlapped, or tied around the waist.

terms.label: sheath skirt
terms.definition: Straight narrow skirt fitted close through the hips with little or no flare toward the hem.

terms.label: skater skirt
terms.definition: Short circular or strongly A-line skirt that flares immediately from the waist.

terms.label: Slip Skirt
terms.definition: Fluid, minimally constructed skirt inspired by a slip, often cut on the bias.

terms.label: Tiered Skirt
terms.definition: Skirt built from multiple horizontal gathered tiers.

terms.label: tulip skirt
terms.definition: Skirt with curved overlapping panels or pleats that create rounded hip volume and a tapered lower edge.

terms.label: tutu skirt
terms.definition: Ballet-derived skirt made from stiff projecting tulle or multiple short net layers.

terms.label: Utility Skirt
terms.definition: Skirt with cargo pockets, straps, tabs, or other functional utility details.

terms.label: wrap skirt
terms.definition: Skirt formed by overlapping front panels and secured at the waist by ties, buttons, or a buckle.

terms.label: Crewneck Sweater
terms.definition: Closed-front knitted pullover with a round crew neckline.

terms.label: Fisherman Sweater
terms.definition: Substantial knitted pullover with prominent cable or Aran-style texture.

terms.label: Half-zip Sweater
terms.definition: Knitted pullover with a short zipper opening at the neck.

terms.label: Mock-neck Sweater
terms.definition: Knitted pullover with a short raised neck that does not fold over.

terms.label: Polo Sweater
terms.definition: Knitted top with a polo collar and short placket or open neck.

terms.label: Short-sleeve Sweater
terms.definition: Knitted pullover whose sleeves end above or around the elbow.

terms.label: Turtleneck Sweater
terms.definition: Knitted pullover with a tall folded or extended neck.

terms.label: V-neck Sweater
terms.definition: Closed-front knitted pullover with a V neckline.

terms.label: Bandeau Bikini
terms.definition: Two-piece swimwear with a strapless band-shaped top.

terms.label: Cutout Swimsuit
terms.definition: One-piece swimwear with substantial deliberate torso cutouts while remaining visibly connected.

terms.label: Halter Bikini
terms.definition: Two-piece swimwear whose top fastens or visually converges behind the neck.

terms.label: High-waist Bikini
terms.definition: Two-piece swimwear with bottoms rising to or above the natural waist.

terms.label: One-piece Swimsuit
terms.definition: Swimwear constructed as one continuous torso-covering garment.

terms.label: Plunge Swimsuit
terms.definition: One-piece swimwear dominated by a visibly deep plunging front neckline.

terms.label: Rash Guard
terms.definition: Close-fitting swim top with athletic coverage, commonly long sleeved and high necked.

terms.label: Tankini
terms.definition: Two-piece swimwear with a tank-top-length upper garment.

terms.label: Triangle Bikini
terms.definition: Two-piece swimwear whose top is formed by triangular cups, usually with narrow straps or ties.

terms.label: Underwire Bikini
terms.definition: Two-piece swimwear with visibly structured bra-like cups and an underwire-derived lower cup line.

terms.label: Baby Tee
terms.definition: Close-fitting, short, small-proportioned T-shirt.

terms.label: Bandeau Top
terms.definition: Strapless narrow band-style top across the chest.

terms.label: Baseball Tee
terms.definition: T-shirt with contrast or clearly diagonal raglan sleeves.

terms.label: Blouse
terms.definition: Soft woven top without classic shirt construction: no button-down collar points or stiff shirt collar; often gathered, ruffled, round- or band-necked, with soft sleeves or cuffs.

terms.label: Bodysuit
terms.definition: Close-fitting one-piece top extending through the crotch, when visually identifiable.

terms.label: Bowling Shirt
terms.definition: Boxy short-sleeve shirt with an open collar and retro panel or piping details.

terms.label: Bralette
terms.definition: Unstructured bra-like top with triangle or lace cups and narrow straps, worn visible alone or under an open or low-cut layer.

terms.label: Bustier Top
terms.definition: Structured fitted top with shaped cups or bodice seaming.

terms.label: Button-up Shirt
terms.definition: Woven shirt with a shirt collar and full button front when no more specific shirt design is visible: collar points are not buttoned down (oxford), no camp collar, western yokes, bowling panels or utility pockets.

terms.label: camisole
terms.definition: Light sleeveless top suspended by narrow shoulder straps and often using lingerie-derived proportions.

terms.label: Camp-collar Shirt
terms.definition: Open-neck shirt with a flat one-piece collar and no top button closure.

terms.label: classic t-shirt
terms.definition: Simple knit top with a round or crew neckline, short sleeves, and no collar or front placket.

terms.label: Cold-shoulder Top
terms.definition: Top with shoulder cutouts while the neckline and sleeves remain connected.

terms.label: Corset Top
terms.definition: Top with visible corset-derived paneling, boning lines, or laced shaping.

terms.label: Crewneck Sweatshirt
terms.definition: Pullover sweatshirt with visible sweatshirt jersey or fleece construction, typically ribbed cuffs or hem, and a round crew neckline; exclude knit sweaters, hoodies and ordinary T-shirts.

terms.label: Graphic Tee
terms.definition: T-shirt whose dominant feature is a placed graphic, image, or lettering.

terms.label: halter top
terms.definition: Top supported or fastened around the neck, leaving the shoulders and much of the upper back exposed.

terms.label: henley shirt
terms.definition: Collarless knit shirt with a short button placket descending from a round neckline.

terms.label: hoodie
terms.definition: Hooded pullover sweatshirt or hooded half-zip whose opening does not continue through the front hem. A full-front zip belongs to Hood Zip-up instead.

terms.label: Mock-Neck Sweatshirt
terms.definition: Pullover sweatshirt with a short raised stand neck that remains unfolded. Sweatshirt construction must be visible; exclude folded turtlenecks, hoodies and knit mockneck sweaters.

terms.label: Muscle Tee
terms.definition: Sleeveless or cut-off T-shirt with broad shoulder coverage and enlarged armholes.

terms.label: Oxford Button-down Shirt
terms.definition: Woven collared shirt with button-fastened collar points and classic shirt construction.

terms.label: peasant top
terms.definition: Loose blouse with a gathered neckline and soft folk-derived volume, often using raglan or puff sleeves.

terms.label: Peplum Top
terms.definition: Fitted top with a flared overskirt or ruffle from the waist.

terms.label: polo shirt
terms.definition: Knit shirt with a folded collar and short front button placket.

terms.label: raglan t-shirt
terms.definition: T-shirt whose sleeves extend diagonally to the neckline without a conventional shoulder seam.

terms.label: ringer t-shirt
terms.definition: T-shirt with visibly contrasting rib trim at the crew neckline and sleeve cuffs.

terms.label: rugby shirt
terms.definition: Substantial knit sport shirt with a collar and short button placket, often using bold horizontal panels or stripes.

terms.label: sailor shirt
terms.definition: Top with a sailor collar characterized by a broad square back and V-shaped front.

terms.label: Sleeveless Top
terms.definition: Everyday women's sleeveless top (ribbed tank, jersey or knit sleeveless, cut-in armholes) that is not bra-shaped athletic wear (tank_top), not a narrow-strap lingerie-style camisole and not neck-fastened (halter_top).

terms.label: smock top
terms.definition: Loose top with a gathered yoke or smocked panel that releases into a full body.

terms.label: tank top
terms.definition: Bra-shaped, close-fitting athletic top for running, yoga or training: sports-bra or bra-length stretch performance top with supportive straps or racerback. Everyday sleeveless tops are sleeveless_top; narrow-strap lingerie-style tops are camisole.

terms.label: Tie-front Top
terms.definition: Top whose front closes or is shaped by a visible tie or knot.

terms.label: tube top
terms.definition: Strapless fitted top formed as a tube around the torso.

terms.label: tunic top
terms.definition: Loose straight top extending below the hips, often with side slits and little waist shaping.

terms.label: Turtleneck Sweatshirt
terms.definition: Pullover sweatshirt with a tall tubular neck that visibly folds or rolls over on itself. Sweatshirt construction must be visible; exclude knitted turtleneck sweaters and short unfolded mock necks.

terms.label: undershirt
terms.definition: Simple close-to-body base-layer top with minimal styling and sleeveless or short-sleeve construction.

terms.label: Utility Shirt
terms.definition: Woven shirt with prominent patch or cargo pockets and functional detailing.

terms.label: V-Neck Sweatshirt
terms.definition: Pullover sweatshirt with a visibly V-shaped neck opening; a decorative V insert beneath a round crew neck does not qualify. Sweatshirt construction must be visible; exclude fine-knit V-neck sweaters.

terms.label: Western Shirt
terms.definition: Shirt with western yokes, snap closures, and pointed pocket details.

terms.label: Wrap Top
terms.definition: Top formed by overlapping front panels that wrap or simulate wrapping.

terms.label: Denim Vest
terms.definition: Sleeveless vest or jacket-like layer visibly constructed from denim, usually with a button front.

terms.label: Fleece Vest
terms.definition: Sleeveless outer layer in visible fleece, pile, or sherpa-like material.

terms.label: Longline Vest
terms.definition: Sleeveless tailored or soft outer layer extending well below the hip.

terms.label: Puffer Vest
terms.definition: Quilted insulated sleeveless outer layer; fill type must be stored separately when known.

terms.label: Sweater Vest
terms.definition: Sleeveless knitted pullover, usually with ribbed edges.

terms.label: Tailored Waistcoat
terms.definition: Fitted sleeveless tailored garment with a button front and suit-style construction.

terms.label: Utility Vest
terms.definition: Functional sleeveless layer with multiple utility or cargo pockets.

terms.label: Barrel
terms.definition: Curved outward volume through the middle that narrows at both ends.

terms.label: Boxy
terms.definition: Straight, squared silhouette with little waist shaping.

terms.label: Cocoon
terms.definition: Rounded volume that tapers toward the hem.

terms.label: Column
terms.definition: Long narrow vertical silhouette with minimal flare.

terms.label: Slouchy
terms.definition: Soft relaxed silhouette with deliberate collapse or drape.

terms.label: Trapeze
terms.definition: Narrow upper body expanding broadly toward the hem without waist shaping.

terms.label: Bodycon Fit
terms.definition: Body-contouring fit closely following torso and hips.

terms.label: Cropped Boxy Fit
terms.definition: Short and broad fit with a squared body.

terms.label: Relaxed Fit
terms.definition: Intentionally easy fit with moderate extra room.

terms.label: Slim Fit
terms.definition: Close but not skin-tight fit through the relevant body area.

terms.label: Ankle Length
terms.definition: Ends at or just above the ankle.

terms.label: Cropped
terms.definition: Ends clearly above the conventional length for the item.

terms.label: Mid-thigh Length
terms.definition: Ends around the middle of the thigh.

terms.label: Puddle Length
terms.definition: Extends past the foot and visibly pools over footwear or floor.

terms.label: Upper-thigh Length
terms.definition: Ends below the hip but high on the thigh.

terms.label: Waist Length
terms.definition: Ends around the natural waist.

terms.label: Boucle Appearance
terms.definition: Looped, nubby, or curly yarn surface associated with boucle.

terms.label: Canvas Appearance
terms.definition: Firm plain-woven utility fabric appearance.

terms.label: Chiffon Appearance
terms.definition: Light sheer fluid woven appearance; fiber is not inferred.

terms.label: Chunky Knit
terms.definition: Heavy knit with thick yarn, large visible stitches, cables or textured stitch patterns.

terms.label: Corduroy
terms.definition: Parallel raised wale texture.

terms.label: Crochet
terms.definition: Visible looped openwork made in crochet-like construction.

terms.label: Denim
terms.definition: Visible denim twill appearance; do not infer fiber percentage.

terms.label: Fine-gauge Knit
terms.definition: Smooth flat sweater or cardigan knit with small even stitches and no pronounced ribs or cables.

terms.label: Fleece Appearance
terms.definition: Soft brushed or pile fleece surface.

terms.label: Jersey Appearance
terms.definition: Smooth fine knit with soft drape and no visible ribs, as in T-shirts, tank tops and soft dresses; fiber is not inferred.

terms.label: Lace
terms.definition: Decorative openwork textile with floral or geometric motifs.

terms.label: Linen Appearance
terms.definition: Woven cloth with visible slubs and soft irregular creasing associated with linen; fiber is not inferred.

terms.label: Mesh
terms.definition: Open net-like or perforated textile structure.

terms.label: Metallic Textile
terms.definition: Textile surface with a metallic reflective effect.

terms.label: Nylon Shell Appearance
terms.definition: Smooth light synthetic-looking shell with sheen and soft crinkle, as in windbreakers, puffers and nylon bags; fiber is not inferred.

terms.label: Openwork Knit
terms.definition: Knitted fabric with deliberate visible holes or mesh-like stitches.

terms.label: Organza Appearance
terms.definition: Sheer crisp fabric holding structured volume; fiber is not inferred.

terms.label: Patent Leather Appearance
terms.definition: Highly glossy coated leather or leather-like surface.

terms.label: Plain Woven Appearance
terms.definition: Matte crisp woven cloth such as shirting or poplin with clean folds and no visible knit loops; fiber is not inferred.

terms.label: Ribbed Knit
terms.definition: Knitted surface with pronounced vertical or horizontal ribs.

terms.label: Ripstop Appearance
terms.definition: Technical woven surface with a visible reinforcement grid.

terms.label: Satin Appearance
terms.definition: Smooth lustrous woven appearance; fiber is not inferred.

terms.label: Sherpa Appearance
terms.definition: Thick curly pile resembling shearling.

terms.label: Smooth Leather Appearance
terms.definition: Smooth leather or leather-like surface; authenticity is not inferred.

terms.label: Tailored Cloth Appearance
terms.definition: Dense matte suiting or coating cloth holding a structured shape, as in blazers, tailored trousers and wool-look coats; fiber is not inferred.

terms.label: Terry Appearance
terms.definition: Looped or towel-like surface texture.

terms.label: Tulle
terms.definition: Fine lightweight net with transparent volume.

terms.label: Tweed Appearance
terms.definition: Visibly textured multitone woven surface associated with tweed.

terms.label: Velvet Appearance
terms.definition: Dense pile surface with directional sheen.

terms.label: Breton Stripe
terms.definition: Regular horizontal nautical-style stripes.

terms.label: Color Block
terms.definition: Large distinct areas of contrasting solid color.

terms.label: Gingham
terms.definition: Even small checks formed by crossing colored and white stripes.

terms.label: Glen Plaid
terms.definition: Complex small and large checks associated with Glen check.

terms.label: Jacquard Pattern
terms.definition: Pattern visibly woven into the fabric rather than surface printed.

terms.label: Logo Repeat
terms.definition: Repeated visible logos used as the dominant surface pattern.

terms.label: Monogram Pattern
terms.definition: Repeated initials, symbols, or brand marks forming an allover pattern.

terms.label: Ombre
terms.definition: Gradual transition between colors or tones.

terms.label: Pinstripe
terms.definition: Very narrow regularly spaced vertical stripes.

terms.label: Polka Dot
terms.definition: Regular repeated circular dots.

terms.label: Tartan Plaid
terms.definition: Multicolor crossing bands associated with tartan structure.

terms.label: Tie-dye
terms.definition: Irregular radiating or clouded resist-dye pattern.

terms.label: Windowpane Check
terms.definition: Large sparse grid formed by thin crossing lines.
